places.name: Rijksmuseum
places.ai_summary: A world-renowned museum showcasing Dutch art and history, including masterpieces by Rembrandt and Vermeer.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.

attribution.title: South facade of the Rijksmuseum Amsterdam (DSCF0528)
attribution.author: Trougnouf (Benoit Brummer)
attribution.description: South facade of the Rijksmuseum Amsterdam

places.name: Anne Frank House
places.ai_summary: The historic house where Anne Frank wrote her diary, now a museum dedicated to her life and legacy.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking required.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds.

attribution.title: Amsterdam (NL), Anne-Frank-Huis -- 2015 -- 7185
attribution.author: Dietmar Rabich
attribution.description: Anne Frank House (black facade at ground level) on the Prinsengracht in Amsterdam, Netherlands

places.name: Van Gogh Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the works of Vincent van Gogh, featuring his paintings, drawings, and letters.

opening_hours.notes: Extended hours on Fridays.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Sunflowers painting.

places.name: Canal Cruise (UNESCO Canals)
places.ai_summary: A scenic cruise through Amsterdam's historic canals, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

opening_hours.notes: Departs every 30 minutes.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can be windy on the water.

places.name: Dam Square
places.ai_summary: The central square of Amsterdam, known for its historical significance and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Always open, but best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Watch out for street performers and pigeons.

attribution.title: Dam Square 2024
attribution.author: Fernando
attribution.description: Dam Square with the Royal Palace and the National Monument.

places.name: Royal Palace of Amsterdam
places.ai_summary: The palace where the Dutch royal family resides, offering tours and a glimpse into royal life.

opening_hours.notes: Check for royal events that may close the palace to visitors.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Dam Square.

attribution.title: Palacio Real, Ámsterdam, Países Bajos, 2016-05-30, DD 07-09 HDR
attribution.author: Diego Delso
attribution.description: Blue hour view of front of the Royal Palace, Amsterdam, Netherlands. The palace was built as a city hall during the Dutch Golden Age and opened in 1655. The building became the royal palace of King Louis Napoleon and later of the Dutch Royal House. Currently it is one of the 3 palaces at the disposal of the monarch.

places.name: Vondelpark
places.ai_summary: Amsterdam's largest city park, perfect for a leisurely stroll, picnic, or bike ride.

opening_hours.notes: Always open, but best enjoyed during the day.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and relax on the grass.

places.name: Heineken Experience
places.ai_summary: An interactive tour through the history of Heineken beer, including tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Try the beer tasting session.

attribution.title: Former Heineken Brewery in Amsterdam
attribution.author: User:Mtcv
attribution.description: Former Heineken brewery in the centre of Amsterdam (Stadhouderskade 78), the Netherlands..

places.name: Jordaan District
places.ai_summary: A charming neighborhood known for its narrow streets, canals, and independent art galleries.

opening_hours.notes: Always open, explore at your own pace.

places.place_tip: Visit the local boutiques and cafes.

places.name: Bloemenmarkt (Floating Flower Market)
places.ai_summary: The world's only floating flower market, selling a colorful array of flowers and plants.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for the freshest flowers.

places.place_tip: Don’t forget to bargain for the best price.

places.name: Rembrandt House Museum
places.ai_summary: The former home of the painter Rembrandt van Rijn, now a museum dedicated to his life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for more in-depth information.

places.name: A’DAM Lookout Tower
places.ai_summary: An observation deck in Amsterdam Noord offering panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events or extended hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a drink at the rooftop bar.

attribution.title: Palacio Real, Ámsterdam, Países Bajos, 2016-05-30, DD 07-09 HDR

The building became the royal palace of King Louis Napoleon and later of the Dutch Royal House. Currently it is one of the 3 palaces at the disposal of the monarch.

places.name: NEMO Science Museum
places.ai_summary: A science museum with interactive exhibits, a rooftop terrace, and stunning views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop terrace for great views.

places.name: Red Light District Walk
places.ai_summary: A guided tour through Amsterdam's famous Red Light District, exploring its history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Respect the local rules and customs.

places.name: Amsterdam Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Amsterdam's history, featuring exhibits from the Middle Ages to the present.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the Amsterdam DNA exhibit.

attribution.title: Ams-above-2007
attribution.author: Fyodor Borisov
attribution.description: Amsterdam Schiphol airport from above. See bigger size: http://www.airliners.net/photo//1305803/L/

places.name: Albert Cuyp Market
places.ai_summary: A famous street market in Amsterdam, known for its diverse food stalls and local products.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on weekdays to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Try the stroopwafels and herring.

attribution.title: Albert Cuypmarkt
attribution.author: Michiel1972 at Dutch Wikipedia

places.name: Begijnhof Courtyard
places.ai_summary: A serene courtyard dating back to the 14th century, once home to the Beguines, a religious community of women.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for peace and quiet.

places.place_tip: Respect the privacy of the residents.

attribution.title: BegijnhofAmsterdamPanorama
attribution.author: Massimo Catarinella
attribution.description: A panorama of the Begijnhof in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

places.name: Magere Brug (Skinny Bridge)
places.ai_summary: A picturesque wooden bridge, one of the most photographed spots in Amsterdam.

opening_hours.notes: Always open, best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Great spot for photos, especially at sunset.

attribution.title: Amsterdam Magere Brug 3
attribution.author: Zairon
attribution.description: Skinny Bridge, Amsterdam, Province of North Holland, Netherlands

places.name: De Pijp Neighborhood
places.ai_summary: A vibrant and multicultural neighborhood, home to the famous Albert Cuyp Market.

opening_hours.notes: Always open, explore at your own pace.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the diverse cuisine and local shops.

attribution.title: Revolutiebouw
attribution.author: A. Bakker
attribution.description: Revolutiebouw in de Daniel Stalpaertstraat; De Pijp, Amsterdam Oud-Zuid

places.name: Artis Royal Zoo
places.ai_summary: The oldest zoo in the Netherlands, featuring a wide variety of animals and a beautiful park.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the zoo's website for feeding times and shows.
